programme.title: And, Kapitan – Josue | E03
programme.desc: Eight profiles of captains of clubs playing in the PKO Bank Polski Ekstraklasa. These are the top players on their teams. They are at different stages of their careers, have different personalities, life principles and stories, but they are united by their love for football and the desire to win. These are eight great leaders. Josue Pesqueira – the leader of Legia Warsaw in recent seasons and an extraordinary personality. One of the best players in the Ekstraklasa. During his career, he represented twelve clubs. He played, among others, in FC Porto, Galatasaray Istanbul, Sporting Braga and Hapoel Beer Sheva. The Military Captain is a leader who takes responsibility for the team. At the same time, he is a scandalist who often lets go of his brakes. He is loved in Warsaw, the rest of Poland hates him. Poland. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: I was a king – Kazimierz Kmiecik | S01E04
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Kazimierz Kmiecik is a legend of Wisła Kraków. He was associated with it both as a player and as a coach. To this day, he is the best scorer in the history of the White Star. He scored 153 goals in 304 matches played. Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.title: Big Brother Oasis | E01
programme.desc: A nature series devoted to the world's first artificial waterhole and the animals that use it. It was created in a reserve in Tanzania, an area of ​​the African savannah with poor water resources. It is not only an excellent vantage point for hidden cameras, but also a place of respite for wild animals such as lions, baboons, elephants, giraffes and buffalos. Thanks to hidden cameras, scientists want to track the secret behaviors of creatures gathering around the waterhole. They are wondering, among other things: whether half-year changes affect their customs and how predators and their prey coexist on a daily basis. For creatures such as lions, baboons, elephants, giraffes and buffalos, the waterhole is a place of respite. It is a field of observation for scientists. Researchers are wondering how predators and potential prey coexist. Great Britain, USA. 2020. nature series

programme.title: Big Brother Oasis | E02
programme.desc: A nature series devoted to the world's first artificial waterhole and the animals that use it. Thanks to hidden cameras, scientists want to track the secret behaviors of creatures gathering around the waterhole. They are wondering, among other things: whether half-year changes affect their customs and how predators and their prey coexist on a daily basis. During the hottest season of the year, thirsty animals come to water only in the evening and at night. It is cooler during this time. However, water-hungry creatures must be careful because they may encounter hyenas under the cover of darkness. Great Britain, USA. 2020. nature series

programme.desc: A plane crash occurs in the middle of the Arctic tundra. The only passenger on the plane is Overgard (Mads Mikkelsen), who manages to escape unscathed. At first, he believes that help will come soon and he persistently maintains some semblance of communication with the world by broadcasting a radio message about his situation. One day, hope for rescue appears when Overgard sees the outline of a helicopter on the horizon. However, it crashes into the ice. The girl found in the wreck motivates him to act. programme.title: 30 for 30: The Good, The Bad, The Hungry
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: Brazil Untamed: The Pantanal (S1E10). Documentary about nature. USA, 2015. S1, Ep10
programme.desc: 2015 г. Год: 2015. Страна: JAV. Год: 2015. S1, Ep10 «Brazil Untamed»…The Pantanal is one of the world's great reservoirs for plant and animal life. Scientists estimate that it's home to 80 species of mammals, 650 species of birds, 50 species of reptiles, and over 300 species of fish. It's the largest tropical wetland on Earth, yet it's also one of the most unforgiving habitats to call homeThe mesmerising wildlife of Brazil is revealed in this fascinating documentary series. Focussing on the Pantanal, the world's largest tropical wetlands, a team of scientists and camera crew study the remarkable creatures that inhabit the area. Predominantly located in the state of Mato Grosso do Sul, though also spreading into Mato Grosso, as well as Bolivia and Paraguay, this unique ecosystem is home to some of Brazil's most captivating species. The team work day and night to track these wonderful animals, including Capuchin monkeys, jaguars, giant otters, maned wolves, capybaras and a wealth of exotic birdsDirector: Emmanuelle Wiecha

programme.title: Supersenses: Super Sight (S1E1). Documentary about nature. England, 2019. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2019 г. Год: 2019. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2019. S1, Ep1 «Supersenses»…Our human senses are pretty incredible – but we only see, hear and smell a tiny fraction of what's out there. There is a hidden world that animals across the globe can experience. In this episode explore the extraordinary sense of sight in the animal world. We travel through the colours of the rainbow, across the spectrum of light our eyes can see – and beyond. Presenters Helen Czerski and Patrick Aryee reveal how caribou use UV light to avoid wolves, they discover how seeing in slow motion lets dragonflies make a kill in the blink of a human eye, and they show how one animal can see in pitch dark – without using its eyesDirector: Carolyn DoddCast: Chris Mchallem

programme.title: Supersenses: Super Powers (S1E2). Documentary about nature. England, 2019. S1, Ep2

programme.title: d/f Belovezhskaya Pushcha
programme.desc: The first time you enter Belovezhskaya Pushcha as an ordinary park, the Master, the rightful owner. You breathe greedily in the resinous air until your head hurts, you break the rough tree bark, tear leaves, or even grind some small insect into dust. Just like that, out of half-childish inquisitiveness. It seems to you that all this is yours, it seems normal that man is always insatiable, and nature is always generous. But as soon as you step away from the beaten path, the first delights are replaced by slight fear: are you the master of all this thousand-year-old thicket? And you are already afraid of your loneliness, your insignificance, your weakness in front of the centuries-old pines, because a person has only the knowledge that civilization has given him, and the Pushcha has the memory of all the deeds of man. Director: Liliya Samoilova. Belarus

programme.desc: Hai khám phá tình cờ vào những năm 1950 đã biến những vật liệu công nghiệp tầm thường thành đồ chơi huyền thoại. Etch A Sketch và Play-Doh sẽ thu về hàng tỷ USD trong nhiều thập kỷ tới, nhưng không phải ai cũng gặt hái được thành quả.

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST MYSTERIES S4 EP20
programme.desc: Trong nhiều thế kỷ, khu vực Đại Tây Dương rộng 500.000 dặm vuông này là dải đại dương khét tiếng nhất trên Trái đất. Đó là nơi tàu, máy bay và những du khách không nghi ngờ đã bị mất tích.

programme.title: WORLD WAR II WITH TOM HANKS EP11
programme.desc: Quân Đồng minh hy vọng có thể nhanh chóng xâm nhập vào Đế chế Đức Quốc xã thông qua Ý nhưng thay vào đó họ lại phải chịu đựng một công việc khó khăn kéo dài nhiều tháng với kết quả tàn khốc.

programme.title: WORLD WAR II WITH TOM HANKS EP12
programme.desc: Lực lượng không quân đồng minh tham gia vào một trận chiến khốc liệt và tốn kém với Luftwaffe của Đức trên bầu trời châu Âu.

programme.title: THE MEGA-BRANDS THAT BUILT THE WORLD S3 EP17
programme.desc: Levi Strauss hợp tác với một thợ may, người đã có một khám phá mang tính đột phá trong Cơn sốt vàng - khơi dậy cơn sốt quần jean xanh và sự cạnh tranh gay gắt giữa hai công ty mang tính biểu tượng trải dài nhiều thế hệ.

programme.title: HISTORY'S DEADLIEST WITH VING RHAMES S1 EP07
programme.desc: Chỉ cần một tia lửa là đủ. Từ thảm họa Hindenburg đến vụ phun trào núi lửa dữ dội ở Krakatoa năm 1883, những vụ nổ này nằm trong số những vụ nổ nguy hiểm nhất trong lịch sử.

programme.title: THE PICKERS S18 EP330
programme.desc: Ở Tây Virginia, anh em nhà Wolfe chọn một cửa hàng nước ngọt có tuổi đời hàng thế kỷ đã bị thời gian đóng băng. Và một mục sư Methodist đồng thời là người chỉ huy rạp xiếc mở cửa cho bộ sưu tập bắt mắt của mình.

programme.title: THÁM HIỂM CONGO CÙNG BEN FOGLE - INTO THE CONGO WITH BEN FOGLE
programme.desc: Trong chặng đầu tiên của hành trình, Ben đến thủ đô Brazzaville nhộn nhịp và tận hưởng cuộc sống của Congo, nếm thử các món ngon địa phương ở chợ đường phố, bao gồm sâu bướm và sâu bọ.

programme.title: KHÁM PHÁ NƯỚC Ý CÙNG STANLEY TUCCI - STANLEY TUCCI: SEARCHING FOR ITALY
programme.desc: Stanley Tucci thăm Veneto, quê hương của 'thành phố nổi' Venice. Anh khám phá sự khéo léo của người Venice và văn hóa ẩm thực của họ, bắt nguồn từ môi trường nước và những ảnh hưởng toàn cầu.

programme.title: GUY KHÁM PHÁ VIỆT NAM - OUR GUY IN VIETNAM
